question: When standardising features for a train/test split, where should you fit the scaler and how should you transform the test set?
answer: Fit the scaler using only the training set. Apply that same fitted scaler to both the training and test sets so held-out statistics cannot influence training.
reference: Fit preprocessing on training data alone and reuse the fitted transformation on held-out data.

criteria.description: Fit the scaler on training data alone to prevent leakage.
Transform the test set using the fitted training scaler.

critical_misconceptions.fit-on-all: Fit on the complete dataset before splitting.
